title: Fix Repo Client Build Script
description: repo/client: get it building; root npm run build:repo-cli currently fails because the script is missing while build:repo-client exists.
summary: Added the missing root npm script build:repo-cli as an alias to the existing build:repo-client target. Verified npm run build:repo-cli completes and npx nx build repo/client --skip-nx-cache performs the Go build successfully.
